name: benzene_anharm_v3_2026-11-19
purpose: TASKS 255 and 211: benzene through pipeline 0.14 with the anharmonic step asked for (--anharmonic-minutes 120), the step now on format 3 of its artefact (probes/anharmonic_step/x2star_v3.json) and the set-wise mode match (probes/s2_xtb_read.match_sets, merge 3dccea10). The GFN2-xTB force field is computed by the pipeline itself from its own geometry, in its own systemd scope (probes/run_in_scope.sh, 1536 MB, 2 dxtb processes). Steps 2-3 come from the corpus (--reuse-only). The same command as probes/runspecs/pipeline_benzene_anharmonic.json (the first run of 17 Nov) with a new result folder, so the first run's record stays. Read: python probes/results_m1/anharmonic_step_2026-11-17/first_run_checks.py <out>/benzene (the second version of the four checks; its step tolerance, 0.3 x the family's bar, 2 cm-1 at most, plus 0.1, was set on 17 Nov after the first run, knowing its 1.7 cm-1). Expected from the replay of the first run's saved files on v3: 28 of 30 bands stepped, the 1655 degenerate pair kept.
command: env CORPUS_QC_PYTHON=C:/Users/thebr/.conda/envs/qc/python.exe PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m m08.pipeline --name benzene --smiles c1ccccc1 --out ../../probes/results_m1/pipeline_benzene_anharmonic_v3_2026-11-19 --threads 4 --reuse-only --anharmonic-minutes 120

estimate.basis: benzene's force field and label took 458 s on 17 Nov 2026 (pipeline_benzene_anharmonic); steps 1-5 with the corpus's steps 2-3 reused take under a minute (probes/runspecs/pipeline_benzene_reuse.json)

memory.basis: a bound for the WSL side: probes/run_in_scope.sh runs the force field and its label in a systemd scope with MemoryMax 1536 MB and no swap (the first run peaked at 1042 MB); beside it the Windows python of the pipeline with the network's checkpoints and kernel ridge on 1,600 rows: under 0.8 GB. --reuse-only: neither psi4 nor pyscf runs
